title: What Happens If It Gets Windy During a Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: The skipper slows down, moves guests back, rethinks the swim stop and turns early if needed. On the south coast, wind usually means a wetter ride, not danger.
heroAlt: Drone view of a white motor boat heading home past Ponta da Cruz on a breezy afternoon
keywords: what happens if it gets windy during a boat trip in Madeira
is it too windy for a boat trip Madeira
will I get wet on a boat trip
boat trip turned back wind Funchal

images.prompt: Drone photograph from about 40 metres up and directly behind a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, mid-afternoon in May. The boat heads east at an easy pace past the headland of Ponta da Cruz, west of Funchal, Madeira, leaving a short white wake. The deep blue sea around it is scattered with small white crests, a fan of spray at the bow. Two small guests seen from behind sit at the stern in light jackets. Sunny with fast-moving white clouds and their shadows on the water, the hotels and cliffs of the Lido coast to the left. Realistic photograph, true colours.
images.alt: Drone view of a white motor boat heading home past Ponta da Cruz on a breezy afternoon
